.. change::
    :tags: use case, asyncio
    :tickets: 12803

    Added two-phase transaction support to the asyncio extension.
    :meth:`_asyncio.AsyncConnection.begin_twophase` returns an
    :class:`_asyncio.AsyncTransaction` which provides the
    :attr:`_asyncio.AsyncTransaction.is_two_phase` and
    :attr:`_asyncio.AsyncTransaction.xid` attributes as well as the
    :meth:`_asyncio.AsyncTransaction.prepare` method, and the
    :meth:`_asyncio.AsyncConnection.recover_twophase`,
    :meth:`_asyncio.AsyncConnection.commit_prepared` and
    :meth:`_asyncio.AsyncConnection.rollback_prepared` methods proxy
    the corresponding core methods.
